description: Stage-1 MCP server allowlist. Per CLAUDE.md §56 + the 2026-05-04 enterprise-architecture page's brutal rule: do not allow direct MCP access. Every MCP call goes through this allowlist + PolisAI + audit. Adding a server requires the §56 6-gate adoption process.

servers.name: drills
servers.rationale: Drill execution can spawn subprocesses + restart services. High-risk; operator-only by default.

servers.name: deploy
servers.rationale: Deployment surface; CRITICAL risk. Operator confirm required for every call.

servers.name: hr
servers.rationale: HR/people data lookups; medium risk per PII.

servers.name: ollama
servers.rationale: LLM gateway; high-risk per token-cost + prompt-injection surface.

servers.name: tests
servers.rationale: Test execution; can mutate test artifacts.

servers.name: paperclip
servers.rationale: Stage-1 read-only sandbox aggregator. Drill-locked no-write contract.

deny_rationale: MCP server not in allowlist. Add a row + run §56 6-gate adoption process before invoking.
